title: Hanging Garden
brief: a hanging garden that grows off a shaft wall (mixed directions)

footprint.note: occupies the 2x1-cell strip of void in front of a shaft wall for 6 levels; the wall face is the footprint's north edge (y = 1)

requires.note: a solid shaft or core wall with open void in front

placement.daylight: grows in shade; +30% growth with a light well or daylight

light_air.note: cleans shaft air; trays barely shade

land_value.note: views of greenery raise value across the shaft

noise.note: foliage and falling water mask shaft noise

construction.name: anchors
construction.action: bolt the timber trellis to the wall, then the knee-brace brackets and the irrigation riser

construction.name: trays
construction.action: lift the three planting trays onto the brackets

construction.name: planting
construction.action: soil, grass and trees on the trays; rail the outer edges; plant climbing vines on the trellis

construction.name: wall growth
construction.action: trailing vines under every tray, sideways trees and moss panels out of the trellis, baskets hung under the trays

construction.name: cascade
construction.action: set the basin on the lowest tray and open the spout under the top tray
